title: Stock reservation lifecycle and last-item race

card.i_want: my checkout to reserve stock atomically with a TTL
card.so_that: two of us cannot both succeed on the last unit and stock never goes negative

context: Reserve on confirm (not add-to-cart); a 30-minute TTL auto-releases; payment converts to sold; failure/timeout/cancel releases; concurrent last-item checkouts yield exactly one winner.

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: reserve on confirm and auto-release on TTL
acceptance_criteria.when: a customer confirms and does not pay within 30 minutes
then: the unit is reserved at confirm
the reservation auto-releases back to available after the TTL

given: a product with 1 unit available and two simultaneous confirms
acceptance_criteria.when: both customers confirm at nearly the same time
then: the other is rejected with an out-of-stock error at confirm, not at payment

given: a reservation already taken for a confirm
acceptance_criteria.when: the reserve operation is retried for the same confirm

then: an audit event {event, actor, ts, sku, before, after, audit_id} is emitted

pii_fields.justification: stock counts carry no personal data

audit_events.justification: reservations and releases change sellable inventory and are audited

idempotency.justification: a retried reserve/release must apply once

reversibility.justification: release is the compensating action for unpaid/failed/cancelled holds
reversibility.compensating_action: release reserved units on TTL, payment failure/timeout, or cancel-before-pay

authn_authz.justification: reservations are system-driven and scoped to the confirming customer's order

regulatory.justification: operational stock integrity, no regulated processing
